verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents Fast serverless variants built for latency-sensitive workloads that aim for 100+ tokens per second. Dedicated on-demand deployments offer lower latency and higher throughput, and speculative decoding and quantization speed up generation. A first-party benchmarking tool measures throughput and latency. missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token figures or guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation

citations.quote: Fast — high-speed deployments for latency-sensitive workloads. Selected by switching the model ID to a Fast variant
Fast variants aim for 100+ tokens per second
Better performance – Lower latency, higher throughput, and predictable performance unaffected by other users
Speculative decoding reduces generation latency by proposing multiple tokens and letting the target model verify them in parallel.
Test throughput and latency under various load conditions
